data.one_liner: Resize images using native implementations with PNG output.
data.what_it_does: Resizes various image formats (JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP, BMP, WBMP) using native implementations for performance. It outputs the resized image exclusively as PNG.
use_when: You need to quickly resize images on-device using native performance.
You only require PNG as the output format for resized images.
avoid_when: You need output formats other than PNG, such as JPEG or WebP.
You require complex image manipulation or editing features beyond resizing.
strengths: Uses native implementations for fast image resizing compared to pure Dart packages.
Supports multiple input formats including animated GIFs and WebP.
weaknesses: Limited functionality focused solely on resizing.

alternatives.name: image
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides extensive pure-Dart image decoding, encoding, and manipulation capabilities for various formats.

data.minimal_example:
final rawImage = await rootBundle.load('assets/someImage.png');
final bytes = await resizeImage(Uint8List.view(rawImage.buffer), width: 150);
